## What changes and why

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List commands and results. Distinguish source checks, mock gateways, and real backends.

## Review notes

Mention protocol compatibility, deployment impact, and remaining limitations.

- [ ] No credentials, private deployment details, model weights, or raw production logs are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and acceptance claims match the change.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
